description_en: The Guitaḥ Gaṇeśa Mandira (Temple) is one of the two Gaṇeśa Temples located at the Guitaḥ Ṭola (seeLAL2030). This is an area or local deity (sthānadeva) of the community members residing in the Guitaḥ Ṭola. Residents of this area worship Guiṭaḥ Gaṇeśa before they perform any auspicious rituals or rites of passage, such as initiation, marriage, birthday and the likes. The Temple has two stories and faces south.This Temple houses a stone Gaṇeśa statue in its sanctum. L.Bangdel(1995, 230) has dated the statue to be from the 18thCentury CE. The door to the sanctum capped by atoraṇaon which a Gaṇeśa image is carved, is flanked by a pair of lions. Both the door andtoraṇaare wrapped in brass.There are no historical sources to date the initial construction of the Temple. It had suffered damages during the 1934 CE (NS 1054) earthquakes. The bell placed in front of the Temple had also suffered damages during that earthquakes. It was later renovated (cf. H.Vajrācārya1999, 75). In 1945 CE (NS 1065), a plinth (peṭī) encircling the Temple was constructed and acākaḥdalūwas offered to the Temple (H.Vajrācārya1999, 77).Every year on the day of the Īndra Jātrā Festival, a brass Gaṇeśa statue is placed in front of the main statue in the sanctum for public display and worshipped. On this day,samaybajiis offered to the deity (note that it is offered outside of the Temple).
description_ne: गुइत: टोलमा रहेका दुईवटा गणेश मन्दिरमध्ये यो गुइत: टोलको थान गणेशको मन्दिर हो । त्यसैले गुइत: टोलमा कसैको पास्नी, व्रतबन्ध, भीमरथारोहण जस्ता संस्कार गर्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले यहीँ आएर पूजा गर्नुपर्ने परम्परा रहिआएको छ ।दुई तहको छाना रहेको यो मन्दिर दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको छ । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा दक्षिणाभिमुख गरी ढुंगाको गणेश स्थापना गरिएको छ । यस मूर्तिलाई ईशाको १८ औं शताब्दीको मानिएको छ (Bangdel L.1995, 230) ।मन्दिरको गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने पेटीको दायाँबायाँ एक जोडी ढुङ्गाको सिंह राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकामाथि गणेश अङ्कित काष्ठतोरण राखिएको छ । तोरण र प्रवेशद्वारलाई पित्तलको पाताले मोडिएको छ । यो मन्दिरको स्थापनाबारे थाहा पाइँदैन । नेसं १०५४ (सन् १९३४) को भूकम्पले यो मन्दिर भत्केको थियो । मन्दिर भत्केर मन्दिरको अगाडि चढाइएको घण्टा पनि फुटेकोले पछि जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो(Vajrācārya H.1999, 75)। नेसं १०६५ (सन् १९४५) मा मन्दिरको चारैतिर पेटी बनाईचाक:दलूचढाइएको थियो(Vajrācārya H.1999, 77) ।यस मन्दिरमा प्रत्यके वर्ष इन्द्रजात्राको दिनमा पनि गर्भगृहमा रहेको गणेशको मूर्ति अगाडि पित्तलको अर्को मूर्ति राखिन्छ र मन्दिर बाहिर समयबजि चढाइन्छ ।

historical_events.event_name: Construction of plinth and offering of a cākaḥdalū
historical_events.event_description: Vyaṣāsĩ Jyāpu and his family members from the Guitaḥ Ṭola constructed a plinth encircling the Temple and offeredcākaḥdalū.

historical_events.event_name: Suffered damages during the 1934 CE earthquakes
historical_events.event_description: The Temple as well as the bell placed in front of the Temple had suffered damages during the 1934 CE (NS 1054) earthquakes.
A certain Khidavi Bhāva, his wife and sons renovated the bell (placed in front of the Temple) which had suffered damages during the 1934 CE earthquakes.

historical_events.event_name: Wrapping toraṇa and main door in brass
historical_events.event_description: In the memory of his father Bhimasundha (Bhīmasundara) and mother Siri (Śrī) Thaku, a certain Simicī sponsored to warp thetoraṇaand main door in brass.
